name: Corporate Action Cash Entitlement
definition: Rights for cash entitled to the account owner based on the terms of the corporate action event and the balance of underlying securities.

GrossCashAmount.name: Gross Cash Amount
GrossCashAmount.definition: Amount of money before any deductions and allowances have been made.

NetCashAmount.name: Net Cash Amount
NetCashAmount.definition: Amount of money after deductions and allowances have been made, if any, ie, the total amount +/- charges/fees.

CashInLieuOfShare.name: Cash In Lieu Of Share
CashInLieuOfShare.definition: Cash disbursement in lieu of a fractional quantity of, eg, equity.

CapitalGain.name: Capital Gain
CapitalGain.definition: Amount of money distributed as the result of a capital gain.

EntitledCashAmount.name: Entitled Cash Amount
EntitledCashAmount.definition: Cash amount based on terms of corporate action event and balance of underlying securities, entitled to/from account owner (which may be positive or negative).

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Specifies the exchange rate used to convert the cash entitlement value in another currency.
